CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS newsletter_subscribers (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(255),
  subscribedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS welcome_popup (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '¡Bienvenida a BoraHae Art!',
  subtitle VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT 'Arte anime hecho a mano con amor',
  body TEXT,
  imageUrl VARCHAR(1000),
  buttonText VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Explorar tienda',
  buttonUrl VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT '/tienda',
  showNewsletter BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  delaySeconds INT DEFAULT 2,
  showOnce BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

INSERT INTO welcome_popup (title, subtitle, body, buttonText, buttonUrl, showNewsletter, active, delaySeconds, showOnce)
VALUES (

  TRUE,
  2,
  TRUE
);
